observations.explanation: The method uses a heuristic to trigger reflection and stores the resulting text in working memory for later trials (pp. 3–4). The paper illustrates the agent using reflection to change its plan and retain environment-specific information (pp. 7–8).

The paper reports solving 97% of 134 AlfWorld environments over 12 trials (p. 5), and reports 54% HotPotQA accuracy versus 34% for base ReAct on 100 questions, a 20-point difference (p. 6). The claim appropriately limits its conclusion to the tested settings and proof of concept.

The evaluations cover 134 AlfWorld environments, 100 HotPotQA questions, and 100 WebShop requests (pp. 5–6, 10). WebShop improves only from 33% to 35% with ReflExion (p. 10). The paper does not report evidence establishing robustness across larger samples or independent repeated runs.

The abstract reports 51% HotPotQA success (p. 1), while the results section reports 54% (p. 6); the paper does not explain the difference in the supplied text. Thus the reported endpoint is uncertain.
